messages:
Elaine: Quick question — for the /generate endpoint what do we want to return when the request fails model-side due to input length vs when the model OOMs? 4xx vs 5xx?
Raj: For input length (client-provided) that should be 4xx (400) with a validation error. OOM is infra, so 5xx and marked retryable.
Tomas: Agree. Also is partial output + error a 200 with an error envelope, or a non-2xx? We have some clients expecting partial tokens streamed even if the final token fails.
Elaine: Good point. Product wants streaming preserved for UX (deliver partial tokens) but we need clear contract if the final completion is incomplete.
Kayla: Proposal: stream tokens as usual, then emit a final envelope event with status field: `{"status":"incomplete","code":502,"reason":"model_oom"}` and close stream with non-2xx HTTP code (502) in the final response metadata. Clients that ignore final metadata still get partial tokens.
Raj: Slight concern — streaming with a later non-2xx breaks a lot of HTTP clients. Maybe keep HTTP 200 for stream transport and include an explicit terminal event in the stream that carries the 5xx code semantics. For non-streaming, return 5xx.
Tomas: Echo Raj. Transport-level 200 for streaming (since chunking happens), terminal event inside stream for retryability. For non-chunked requests, return proper 4xx/5xx HTTP.
Elaine: Sounds reasonable. What about validation errors discovered server-side during tokenization (e.g., unsupported characters)? 4xx or 422?
Kayla: Use 422 for semantic validation (unprocessable) and 400 for syntactic issues. Keep a small set: 400, 422, 429, 5xx.
Raj: Also add `retryable` boolean in the error envelope payload to make client logic simpler: `{"code":502,"retryable":true}`.
Tomas: +1. And we should document idempotency guidance for retries: only safe to retry when request has idempotency key or when the error is marked `retryable` and operation type is read-only.
Elaine: Action items: 1) Docs PR to add streaming-terminal-event pattern and example (Kayla), 2) Runtime change to emit terminal event on infra errors (Tomas), 3) Add `retryable` flag to error envelope and HTTP status mapping (Raj). I'll open a meta PR tracking the three.
Kayla: I'll draft the docs and include example snippets. Example envelope I plan to add:
```
{"error": {"message": "model ran out of memory during decode","code": "model_oom","http_status": 502, "retryable": true}}
```
Raj: Minor: recommend `code` as short snake_case and `http_status` numeric for machines.
dev-bot: CI: build/test for `api-spec` failed on `spec/error-handling.md` (see https://ci.redwood.ai/1234) :red_circle:
Tomas: I'll take the runtime change and add a test for streaming terminal events.
Elaine: Cool. Raj, can you add the `retryable` field to the spec PR? I want this in the next patch release.
Raj: Yup will do, ping me for review when docs PR is up.
Kayla: Drafted initial docs locally, will push in ~30m and link here.
Elaine: Thanks all — we'll sync async. If anyone thinks this needs an RFC instead of a docs PR call it out now.
Tomas: No RFC needed IMO; just make sure tests and examples cover both streaming and non-streaming flows.
Elaine: Closing for now. :thumbsup:
